text: dsh-conv-calendar 是面向 DSH Web 的对话统计插件，会在侧边栏加入「对话日历」页面。它从会话事件和宿主历史查询中汇总每天由用户发送的消息、活跃会话及模型 Token 用量，并以全年贡献网格展示。用户可切换消息、会话、Token 和输出指标，查看统计卡片及每日 Token 拆分；历史数据会去重并保存在本机。适合希望回顾 DSH 使用节奏和用量的人；无需额外 API 密钥，需由宿主提供会话历史查询服务以回填旧记录。

dsh-conv-calendar adds a DSH Web sidebar calendar for daily prompts, sessions, and token usage. Its yearly grid offers four metrics and daily token details, using session events and host history. No API key is needed; historical backfill depends on the host query service.
我想按天看看自己在 DSH 发了多少条消息。
能不能把 DSH 的会话活跃情况画成年度贡献日历？
想统计每天消耗和输出了多少 Token。
在 DSH Web 里加个能查看历史用量的侧边栏页面。
帮我比较每天的消息数、会话数和模型用量。
我想从日历格子里查看某一天的 Token 明细。
Show my daily prompts and token usage in a contribution calendar.
I want a sidebar view of my DSH conversation history by day.
dsh-conv-calendar 的功能「每日活动统计」：按日期汇总用户消息、活跃会话、回复数及输入、输出、缓存和总 Token。页面可在消息、会话、Token、输出指标间切换。
dsh-conv-calendar 的功能「年度日历面板」：从 Web 侧栏打开全年贡献网格，以颜色显示每日活动强度，并在悬停时查看日期统计和 Token 拆分。
dsh-conv-calendar 的功能「历史回填」：页面请求汇总数据时通过宿主 sessionQuery 读取历史会话；可由刷新操作重新回填，单次读取设有时间预算。
dsh-conv-calendar 的功能「本地保存与去重」：按消息标识去重历史与分叉会话记录，并将聚合状态原子写入插件状态文件，避免重复扫描导致重复计数。
dsh-conv-calendar 使用前须知：旧会话回填依赖宿主提供 sessionQuery；该服务不可用时，统计仅包含当前运行期间收到的事件。

dsh-conv-calendar README · dsh-conv-calendar：**English** | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A GitHub-style contribution calendar for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — see how many prompts you sent, how many conversations you had, and how many tokens you burned, one square per day.

<!--
  Screenshots — taken with the UI language set to English.
  Drop the two images into `docs/screenshots/en/` (see `docs/screenshots/README.md`).
  Until they exist these blocks render as alt text only.

---

dsh-conv-calendar README · Features：- **A sidebar entry.** *Conversation calendar* appears in the Web GUI sidebar; clicking it opens a full-page calendar.
- **GitHub-style grid.** The whole current calendar year — always a full year of squares, padded out to whole Monday-started weeks, future days included — five shades, one square per local day.
- **Four metrics.** Switch between **Prompts**, **Conversations**, **Tokens** and **Output**:

dsh-conv-calendar README · Features：| Metric | What one square means |
  | --- | --- |
  | Prompts | How many messages you sent that day |
  | Conversations | How many sessions were active that day |
  | Tokens | Total tokens spent that day (input + output + cache reads) |
  | Output | Tokens the model produced that day |

dsh-conv-calendar README · Features：- **Four stat cards.** This year's total (with active days), current streak (with longest), this month (with last month), this year's busiest day — all of them follow the selected metric. The card figures use the same year scope as the grid; only the streaks keep the full history, because a run can cross 1 January.
- **Token breakdown.** Under *Tokens* and *Output*, hovering a square also shows the `input · output · cached` split; hovering a future square shows its date alone.
- **Theme-aware.** Colors come from DSH theme variables, so light and dark mode both look native.
- **Bilingual.** Follows the UI language (English / Chinese).

dsh-conv-calendar README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** or a compatible build (it relies on the `sidebar.panellist` and `main` slots, and on `ctx.sessionQuery`).
- Node **22.15+** on the Host side (the session logs are zstd-compressed).
dsh-conv-calendar README · Install：```sh
dsh-conv-calendar README · From a local checkout：dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-conv-calendar

dsh-conv-calendar README · From npm (Recommend)：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-conv-calendar
```

Then **restart DeepSeek Harness**. Plugins are composed from the profile's bundle list at startup, so a restart is required — the entry cannot hot-load into a running Host.

After the restart:sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-conv-calendar
```

dsh-conv-calendar README · From npm (Recommend)：> If a plugin ever prevents the app from starting, remove the `"dsh-conv-calendar"` line from `dsh.profile.bundles` in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/package.json` instead of using the recovery dialog, which also resets unrelated settings.

dsh-conv-calendar README · Tokens：Taken from `data.usage` on `assistant/message` events:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `inputTokens` | Input tokens that missed the cache |
| `outputTokens` | Tokens the model produced |
| `cacheReadTokens` | Input tokens served from the cache |
| `totalTokens` | Sum of the three (provider-reported; summed locally when absent) |

Older log entries may omit `cacheReadTokens` (treated as `0`); replies with no `usage` at all are skipped.

dsh-conv-calendar README · Cross-session de-duplication：Forking a session copies its ancestor's log. A copied prompt or reply keeps the same `message.id`, so hashing it lands in the same set and is counted once. That also makes re-reading a log idempotent — re-scanning can never double count.

> **Active days can differ per metric.** A day where the model replied but you sent nothing counts under *Tokens* but not under *Prompts*. That is intended.

dsh-conv-calendar README · Where the data comes from：| Source | Used for | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session/event` feed | Live counting | Every new message, and every reply carrying `usage`, is recorded immediately — no waiting for a disk flush |
| `ctx.sessionQuery` (`listSessions` / `readSession`) | Backfill | History is read through the Host's own decoder: the logs are appended frame by frame, so a single whole-file `zstdDecompressSync` only yields the first frame |

dsh-conv-calendar README · Where the data comes from：A finished session is read once and marked `final`; it is never re-read. A session that is still live is re-read on every refresh and **merged** (union of hashes, so it is idempotent). One backfill pass has an 8-second budget — leftovers resume on the next pass.

dsh-conv-calendar README · HTTP endpoint：The panel reads one read-only endpoint from the same Host process:

```
GET /dsh-conv-calendar/api/summary            # current aggregate (kicks off a background backfill if needed)
GET /dsh-conv-calendar/api/summary?refresh=1  # backfill now (the panel's Refresh button)
```

The response is JSON:

dsh-conv-calendar README · HTTP endpoint：- `days[]` — `{ day, messages, sessions, replies, input, output, cache, total }`
- `meta` — `sessions`, `activeDays`, `totalMessages`, `totalReplies`, `totalInput`, `totalOutput`, `totalCache`, `totalTokens`, `updatedAt`
- `history` — the last backfill report (`available`, `read`, `cached`, `failed`, `partial`)
- `historyPending` — whether a backfill is currently running

dsh-conv-calendar README · HTTP endpoint：The endpoint uses the Host's connection fence (`ctx.connection.requestRejection`): a request without the session cookie gets `401`, so a loopback-only deployment never exposes the numbers.

dsh-conv-calendar README · How it is built：```
dsh-conv-calendar/
├─ package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client (platform: web, inject: …)
├─ cordis.patch.yml      # inserts one row into the profile's config tree
├─ lib/

**No build step.** The browser half is written directly in the platform's factory form: `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` registers a factory, and the module body runs on first use. `react` is resolved from the Host's shared module table.

Two slot contributions, both declaration-aware:

dsh-conv-calendar README · How it is built：```js
ctx.slots.inject('sidebar.panellist', () => ctx.slots.register({ name: 'sidebar.panellist', id: PANEL_ID, order: 20, label: () => t('panel.label'), locale: NS }, CalendarGlyph))
ctx.slots.inject('main', () => ctx.slots.register({ name: 'main', key: PANEL_ID, locale: NS }, CalendarPanel))
```

dsh-conv-calendar README · How it is built：`ctx.slots.inject(name, …)` is deliberate rather than a bare `ctx.slots.register(...)`: a slot's declaration may arrive *after* this plugin, and registering into an undeclared key throws — which the shell surfaces as an entry that "did not activate". `inject` defers the registration until the declaration exists and re-runs it if the contributing package is replaced.

dsh-conv-calendar README · Two Host-side details worth knowing：- **The Loader does not read a function plugin's namespace-level `inject` export.** A function plugin (as opposed to a class plugin) must reach the service imperatively, so the Host half uses `ctx.inject(['webServer'], (inner) => …)`.
- **Client bundles must declare their dependencies** in `package.json` → `dsh.client.inject`. Without it the module graph treats the bundle as dependency-free, may activate it before `ui-renderer` / `ui-layout` / `client-locale`, and the whole app refuses to start.

dsh-conv-calendar README · Tests：`tests/` holds the offline tests. They need their own dependencies, declared in `tests/package.json`:

```sh
cd tests
npm install
npm test        # runs all five
```

Run one on its own with `node token-fold.mjs`, and so on.

dsh-conv-calendar README · Tests：| Test | Needs | What it asserts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `token-fold.mjs` | nothing (Node only) | Folds session logs and compares every day's input/output/cache/total against an independent pass. Uses the real logs under `$DSH_HOME/sessions` when they exist; otherwise it builds a fixture in a temp directory with the same shape — several zstd frames per file, a forked session repeating its ancestor — and asserts the equivalent totals. Also checks legacy v1 days still read, re-recording is idempotent, and usage without `cacheReadTokens` normalizes to 0 |
| `host-contract.mjs` | cordis | Mounts the Host half in the real cordis runtime with stubbed `webServer` / `sessionQuery`: route registration, injected messages ignored, finished sessions read once, live prompts and reply usage recorded immediately, replies without usage contributing nothing, `HEAD`/`POST` handling, route removal on dispose |
| `panel-render.mjs` | react, jsdom | 371 cells, month labels, tooltip, metric switching, refresh going through `?refresh=1` |
| `panel-states.mjs` | react, jsdom | Empty data still draws the grid plus a hint, failure state offers retry, English copy uses correc

dsh-conv-calendar README · Tests：`module-system-emulation.mjs`, `shell-emulation.mjs` and `slots-probe.mjs` are the diagnostic scripts used to trace the boot failure described above; they are kept as documentation of the investigation and are not part of `npm test`.

dsh-conv-calendar README · Tests：End-to-end verification performed during development: a second Host booted from a temporary profile returned 6 days / 10 sessions / 62 prompts / **253M tokens** from real logs, with each day's input/output/cache matching an independent script exactly; the panel rendered that live payload in jsdom, producing four distinct heatmap patterns, with the token tooltip showing the input/output/cache split; a cookie-less request was refused with `401`.

dsh-conv-calendar README · Limitations：- **Backfill needs `sessionQuery`.** In a composition without it, only the current run is counted and the footer says so.
- **Finished sessions are never re-read.** That is safe because a finished log cannot change; if you rewrite history by hand, delete `state.json`.
- **Only human messages count.** Injected context never does — that is the point.
- **The time zone is the machine's, read at startup.** After travelling, old dates stay filed under the local date they happened on.
dsh-conv-calendar README · License：[MIT](LICENSE)

dsh-conv-calendar README · dsh-conv-calendar · 对话日历：[English](README.md) | **中文**

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 用的 GitHub 风格提交日历 —— 每天发了多少条对话、开了几个会话、烧了多少 token，一格一天，一眼看完。

<!--
  截图 —— 界面语言设为中文时拍摄。
  把两张图放进 `docs/screenshots/zh-CN/`（怎么截见 `docs/screenshots/README.md`）。
  放好之前这里只显示替代文本。
-->

---

dsh-conv-calendar README · 功能：- **侧边栏入口**：Web 界面左侧栏出现「对话日历」图标，点开即是整页日历。
- **GitHub 风格网格**：始终是当前自然年整年 —— 补齐到完整的周一起始周，未到的日子也照样画出格子 —— 5 级配色，一格一个本地日期。
- **四个指标**：「消息 / 会话 / Token / 输出」随时切换。

| 指标 | 一格代表什么 |
  | --- | --- |
  | 消息 | 当天你发出的消息条数 |
  | 会话 | 当天活跃的会话个数 |
  | Token | 当天消耗的 token 总量（输入 + 输出 + 缓存命中） |
  | 输出 | 当天模型产出的 token 数 |

dsh-conv-calendar README · 功能：- **四个数字**：今年合计（含今年活跃天数）、当前连续（含历史最长）、本月（含上月对比）、今年最忙一天 —— 全部随指标切换。前三个口径与网格一致，连续天数按全期算，跨年不截断。
- **Token 明细**：Token / 输出模式下，悬停格子还会显示 `输入 · 输出 · 缓存` 拆分；悬停未来的格子只显示日期。
- **深浅色自适应**：颜色取自 DSH 主题变量，不写死配色，亮色深色都像原生。
- **中英双语**：跟随界面语言。

dsh-conv-calendar README · 环境要求：- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** 或兼容版本（依赖 `sidebar.panellist` 与 `main` 槽位，以及 `ctx.sessionQuery`）。
- 宿主侧 Node **22.15+**（会话日志是 zstd 压缩的）。
dsh-conv-calendar README · 安装：```sh
dsh-conv-calendar README · 本地目录安装：dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/绝对路径/dsh-conv-calendar

dsh-conv-calendar README · 从 npm 安装（推荐）：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-conv-calendar
```

然后**重启 DeepSeek Harness**。插件是在启动时按 profile 的 bundle 列表装配的，无法热加载进正在运行的宿主。

重启后：sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-conv-calendar
```

> 万一某个插件导致应用起不来，请到 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<名字>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉 `"dsh-conv-calendar"` 那一行 —— 不要用恢复对话框，它会连带把你的其他设置一并重置。

dsh-conv-calendar README · 消息：三个条件都成立才计数：

1. 会话事件类型是 `user/message`；
2. `data.source.kind === 'user'`，即**你亲手发出的**。注入的上下文（运行上下文、技能清单、时间上下文、工具提醒……）各有自己的 source，永远不计；
3. 按**本机本地时区**归到某一天。

dsh-conv-calendar README · Token：来自 `assistant/message` 事件的 `data.usage`：

| 字段 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `inputTokens` | 未命中缓存的输入 token |
| `outputTokens` | 模型产出的 token |
| `cacheReadTokens` | 命中缓存的输入 token |
| `totalTokens` | 三者之和（provider 报告值；缺失时本地相加） |

较早的日志可能没有 `cacheReadTokens`，按 `0` 处理；完全没有 `usage` 的回复直接跳过。

dsh-conv-calendar README · 跨会话去重：会话被 fork 时会复制祖先的日志。复制过来的 prompt 和 reply 保持相同的 `message.id`，哈希后落在同一个集合里，所以只算一次。这也让重复读取日志成为幂等操作 —— 重新扫描永远不会重复计数。

> **活跃天数会随指标变化。** 某天只有模型回复、你没有发消息，它在「Token」里算活跃、在「消息」里不算。这是刻意的。

dsh-conv-calendar README · 数据来源：| 来源 | 用途 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session/event` 事件流 | 实时计数 | 每条新消息、每条带 `usage` 的回复立刻入账，不等写盘 |
| `ctx.sessionQuery`（`listSessions` / `readSession`） | 历史回填 | 历史走宿主自己的解码器：日志是逐帧追加的，单次整体 `zstdDecompressSync` 只能解出第一帧 |

已结束的会话只读一次并打上 `final`，之后不再重读；仍在运行的会话每次刷新都会重读并**合并**（哈希取并集，天然幂等）。一次回填有 8 秒预算，超时留下的部分下次继续。

dsh-conv-calendar README · HTTP 接口：面板读同一个宿主进程里的一个只读接口：

```
GET /dsh-conv-calendar/api/summary            # 当前聚合结果（需要时启动一次后台回填）
GET /dsh-conv-calendar/api/summary?refresh=1  # 立即回填（面板上的「刷新」按钮）
```

响应是 JSON：

- `days[]` —— `{ day, messages, sessions, replies, input, output, cache, total }`
- `meta` —— `sessions`、`activeDays`、`totalMessages`、`totalReplies`、`totalInput`、`totalOutput`、`totalCache`、`totalTokens`、`updatedAt`
- `history` —— 最近一次回填的报告（`available`、`read`、`cached`、`failed`、`partial`）
- `historyPending` —— 当前是否有回填在跑
dsh-conv-calendar README · HTTP 接口：接口沿用宿主的连接栅栏（`ctx.connection.requestRejection`）：没有会话 Cookie 的请求拿到 `401`，只监听回环地址的部署不会把数据暴露出去。

dsh-conv-calendar README · 实现说明：```
dsh-conv-calendar/
├─ package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（platform: web、inject: …）
├─ cordis.patch.yml      # 往 profile 配置树里插入一行
├─ lib/

**没有构建步骤。** 浏览器半边直接写成平台的 factory 形式：`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 注册一个工厂，模块体在首次使用时才执行；`react` 从宿主的共享模块表里解析。

两个槽位贡献都写成「声明感知」的形式：

dsh-conv-calendar README · 实现说明：```js
ctx.slots.inject('sidebar.panellist', () => ctx.slots.register({ name: 'sidebar.panellist', id: PANEL_ID, order: 20, label: () => t('panel.label'), locale: NS }, CalendarGlyph))
ctx.slots.inject('main', () => ctx.slots.register({ name: 'main', key: PANEL_ID, locale: NS }, CalendarPanel))
```

用 `ctx.slots.inject(name, …)` 而不是裸的 `ctx.slots.register(...)` 是刻意的：槽位的声明可能晚于本插件到达，而往未声明的 key 注册会抛错 —— shell 会把它显示成「条目未能激活」。`inject` 会等到声明存在再注册，贡献方被替换时也会重跑。

dsh-conv-calendar README · 两个宿主侧的关键细节：- **Loader 不读函数插件命名空间上的 `inject` 导出。** 函数插件（相对于类插件）必须用命令式方式取服务，所以宿主半边用的是 `ctx.inject(['webServer'], (inner) => …)`。
- **浏览器 bundle 必须在 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client.inject` 里声明依赖。** 少了它，模块图会把这个 bundle 当成零依赖，可能让它早于 `ui-renderer` / `ui-layout` / `client-locale` 激活，进而导致整个应用起不来。
section: 两个宿主侧的关键细节

text:
dsh-conv-calendar README · 测试：`tests/` 下是离线测试，依赖写在 `tests/package.json` 里：

```sh
cd tests
npm install
npm test        # 五个一起跑
```

单个跑：`node token-fold.mjs`，其余同理。

dsh-conv-calendar README · 测试：| 测试 | 依赖 | 断言内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `token-fold.mjs` | 无（纯 Node） | 折叠会话日志，逐日对比 input/output/cache/total 与独立统计。有 `$DSH_HOME/sessions` 下的真实日志时读真实日志；没有时在临时目录造一份同构 fixture（一个文件多个 zstd 帧、一个 fork 会话重复祖先事件）并断言等价总量。另外校验 v1 旧格式仍可读、重复记录幂等、缺 `cacheReadTokens` 归一为 0 |
| `host-contract.mjs` | cordis | 在真实 cordis 运行时里挂载宿主半边（桩掉 `webServer` / `sessionQuery`）：路由注册、注入消息被忽略、已结束会话只读一次、实时 prompt 与 reply usage 立即入账、无 usage 的回复不贡献 token、`HEAD`/`POST` 处理、卸载时路由回收 |
| `panel-render.mjs` | react、jsdom | 371 个格子、月份标签、悬停提示、指标切换、刷新走 `?refresh=1` |
| `panel-states.mjs` | react、jsdom | 空数据仍画出网格并给提示、失败态可重试、英文单复数正确 |
| `panel-token.mjs` | react、jsdom | Token / 输出指标、`496k` / `16k` 格式、tooltip 里的 token 拆分，以及四个指标确实会画出不同的热力图案 |

dsh-conv-calendar README · 测试：`module-system-emulation.mjs`、`shell-emulation.mjs`、`slots-probe.mjs` 是排查上面那个启动失败时用的诊断脚本，留作调查过程记录，不在 `npm test` 里。

开发期做过的端到端验证：用临时 profile 启动第二个宿主，从真实日志返回 6 天 / 10 个会话 / 62 条消息 / **253M tokens**，每天 input/output/cache 与独立脚本逐日一致；面板在 jsdom 里渲染该真实 payload，四个指标产生四种不同热力图案，token tooltip 正确显示输入/输出/缓存拆分；无 Cookie 的请求被 `401` 拒绝。

dsh-conv-calendar README · 已知限制：- **回填依赖 `sessionQuery`**：没有挂载该服务的装配里只统计本次运行，页脚会明确提示。
- **已结束会话不重读**：日志一旦完结就不会再变，所以缓存是安全的；如果你手工改写了历史，删掉 `state.json`。
- **只统计真人消息**：注入的上下文永远不计，这是刻意的口径。
- **时区取启动时的本机时区**：跨时区旅行后，旧日期仍归档在它发生时的本地日期下。
dsh-conv-calendar README · 许可证：[MIT](LICENSE)
